28.comment: Williams caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

28.name: Stefon Diggs
28.comment: Diggs caught five of nine targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

28.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
28.comment: Croskey-Merritt carried the ball nine times for a season-low 15 yards and caught two of four targets for 35 yards in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts.

28.name: Athan Kaliakmanis
28.comment: Kaliakmanis completed 15 of 33 passes for 186 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-13 loss to the Colts. He added 16 yards on three carries.

28.name: Tyler Owens
28.comment: Owens (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Colts.

28.name: Jeremy Reaves
28.comment: Reaves (finger) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Colts.

28.name: Charles Omenihu
28.comment: Omenihu (groin) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's Week 4 matchup versus the Colts in London, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

28.name: Percy Butler
28.comment: Butler (concussion) is active for Sunday's game against the Colts in London.

28.name: Frankie Luvu
28.comment: Luvu has no injury designation heading into Sunday's game against the Colts.

28.name: Ben Sinnott
28.comment: Sinnott (ribs) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Colts.
